title: SmoothChat
description: Adds smooth, configurable chat animations (fade/slide) alongside keyboard shortcuts
body:
**SmoothChat** Adds smooth, configurable chat animations and opacity controls, plus a few quality-of-life chat shortcuts.

![example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/730ffeb718fe726b204647b93355f2856d46924e.gif)

**Features**
* Chat background opacity control
* Chat text opacity control
* Fade-in time for new messages
* Slide-in/out animation for incoming messages
* Slide-in animation for the chat input box
* Animation speed settings
* Position/offset settings for animations 
* Ctrl + A to select all text in the chat input
* Up/Down arrows to cycle through previous messages (chat history)

### Warning! 
If you are using **MojangFixStationAPI** you must toggle off the Open/Close Slide Animation, otherwise your input box will be invisible
